headline: Going Commando reaches 84.74% matched code for USA v1.01
summary: Going Commando’s USA v1.01 rises from 66.51% to 84.74% matched code by size, with work spanning boot code, levels and the lock-on tether family. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Ratchet & Clank’s source gets readable names and a new organization while PAL v2.00 stays at 100.00% matched code, and Deadlocked gains PAL routines while its separate NTSC-U v1.00 code figure stays at 6.07%. OpenRAC’s Development channel adds mod dependencies and automatic updates, graphics improvements and Windows fixes, while stable receives a PAL level 11 lighting-bake fix without a launcher release. Mod SDK 1.11.0, Archipelago v2.1.0, Item Randomizer v1.0.4 and Difficulty v1.2.4 are released, bringing room-aware Archipelago saves and a fix for missing Blarg Station spawns, while co-op crossplay and the not-yet-playable Going Commando native port remain drafts.
